panels.title: Per service — requests, limits and usage (% of request, over the selected time range)
panels.description: One row per Deployment / StatefulSet / DaemonSet. Requests and limits are per pod (the chart value). Avg % = average across the service's pods and over time; Max % = highest any pod reached. Percentages are usage ÷ request. Blue < 30% over-reserved · green 30–100% · orange 100–150% · red > 150% under-reserved. 'none' = not set. Containers without a request (e.g. sidecars) are left out of the % so they don't inflate it.

panels.title: Requests, limits and actual usage per running pod (over the selected time range)
panels.description: CPU in millicores (1000m = 1 core); 'no limit' = no limit set. Avg / max sampled every minute across the time range. % of request: blue < 30% (over-reserved), green 30–100%, orange 100–150%, red > 150% (under-reserved). Memory % of limit: green < 75%, orange 75–90%, red > 90% (close to being OOMKilled).
